question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, what mass of activated bamboo-derived biochar (A-BC) was used to make BC-10, and what mass for BC-20?
rendered:
According to the excerpts, the masses of activated bamboo-derived biochar (A-BC) used to make BC-10 and BC-20 were:

* For BC-10: 37.1 mg
* For BC-20: 83.5 mg
